notes:
CRM notes (shorthand, call snippets, action items):
- Company background: product analytics SDK + in-app assistant. Heavy real-time assist usage in UI.
- Current stack: mix of OpenAI API + internal prompt router. Looking to consolidate provider to control costs and latency.
- Primary ask: migrate flows to Redwood Hosted first for quick win, then move critical traffic to Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU) for predictable p95 latency and cost.
- Technical concerns raised by VP Eng: "prompt parity" — we can't afford drift in outputs for billing-critical flows. Also worried about tokenization differences affecting safety filters.
- SE notes (Jordan): propose a compatibility shim that proxies OpenAI-compatible calls to Redwood hosted with param mapping (temperature, top_p, function-calling keys). Build regression harness (parity suite) of ~120 canonical prompts across intents. Use embedding-similarity threshold for reranking regressions.
- POC results so far: hosted smoke matched 86% of golden responses within business thresholds. 14 regressions flagged: 9 due to tokenization differences (special char handling), 3 due to generation style (sampling defaults), 2 due to function-calling schema mismatch.
- Suggested mitigations: token normalization pre-hook, map function-call payloads 1:1, pin model variant and seed-like sampling controls, and use Redwood Optimize to tune batching/quantization for cost.
- Performance: hosted p95 observed ~240-300ms for 1k-token chat in the POC environment; target for dedicated is p95 < 150ms for same workload. Quantive expects 20-30% cost savings with dedicated pool plus caching.
- Security: must support SSO (SAML), audit logs to SIEM, KMS for key management, and EU data residency for subset of customers. Legal: initial DPA comments due 2026-02-18.
- Commercial: Finance wants committed ARR band before Dedicated contract. We're proposing a 12-month committed pool (est. $150k ARR) with step-up option after 6 months.
- Quote from Head of Product on 2026-01-28: "If we can hit parity and save ~25% on token spend, it's an easy win. Main risk is regressions breaking user funnels."
- Next actions: 1) Full parity run across 120 prompts (SE owned, due 2026-02-18). 2) Dedicated sizing workshop (SRE + Infra) week of 2026-02-22. 3) Legal DPA follow-up (owner: Alex).
